📋 Simple 4-Step Process

How SafeReach Works

Automated multi-tier community escalation ensures emergency alerts are received and acted upon within seconds.

01
🔴

Senior Citizen presses SOS

User holds the emergency SOS button for 3 seconds, activating loud synthesized alarm audio and initiating immediate response telemetry.

02
📍

GPS location is captured

High-precision GPS coordinates, apartment unit address, and pre-existing medical conditions are automatically compiled.

03
🛡️

Linked responders receive alert

Tier 1 nearby neighbors and on-duty security guards receive real-time push alerts and Socket.IO broadcasts with live 60s countdown timer.

04
⏱️

Emergency is escalated if required

If not accepted within 60 seconds, the server automatically escalates the alert to family members and registered community volunteers.

✨ Core Capabilities

Built for Speed, Reliability & Safety

Comprehensive real-time emergency infrastructure tailored for residential societies, senior care, and families.

🚨

Instant SOS

Immediate emergency alert broadcasting with 3-second hold to prevent accidental triggers and emit high-priority sirens.

📍

GPS Tracking

Share the senior citizen's live GPS coordinates with authorized responders alongside 1-click Google Maps navigation routing.

👨‍👩‍👧

Family Connection

Connect trusted family members and guardians for instant emergency push notifications, live status feeds, and direct telephone calls.

🛡️

Community Responders

Notify linked nearby neighbors, registered volunteers, and gatehouse security personnel for immediate on-site support.

🔔

Real-Time Notifications

Receive instant alerts through Socket.IO websockets and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notifications with audio alerts.

⏱️

60-Second Escalation

Automated server-side escalation automatically cascades alerts to secondary tier responders when primary contacts are busy.
